luiskr.com / website/components/media/expanded/genie-texture / GenieSheet

Defined in: website/components/media/expanded/genie-texture.ts:36

The composited modal surface the strip-warp backends sample. Coordinates of mediaBox/clipBox are content-local CSS px — the texture ctx carries the dpr/scale transform, so every stamp (bake and per-frame restamp alike) draws in CSS px.
